about_item: 【STUNNING BOHO VIBE】Elevates any tabletop with a romantic,rustic look.Perfect for adding a soft,flowing layer of elegant color to both festive party and daily home decors.
【PREMIUM QUALITY】Hand-dyed soft cotton fabric blending rich gauze and cheesecloth textures.Features meticulously stitched edges to prevent fraying for long-lasting use.
【CREATIVE DECOR】Excellent choice for accenting dining tables,dressing up chairs,or shaping wedding arches.The natural draped hem adds an artistic touch to any space.
【PACKAGE INCLUDES】Contains 1 table runner (35 x 120 inches) and 1 natural jute rope (40 inches) in a clear bag. Versatile length perfectly fits most table sizes.
【EASY CARE & SERVICE】Machine or hand wash. Please note that slight color variations may occur due to screen resolutions.Contact us anytime for support.

summary.text: Customers love the table runner's color, particularly its burnt orange shade perfect for fall, and appreciate its soft gauze material that drapes beautifully. They find it versatile for dining tables and thanksgiving/fall ambiance, with one customer noting it's suitable for formal, casual, or farmhouse everyday use. The material receives positive feedback for being 100% cotton cheesecloth, and customers consider it worth the price. While some customers find it thicker than expected, others mention it looks thin.
